$comment: Privacy gate policy. Acknowledgements expire: an expired entry fails the build.

P001.title: Renter identity and precise location are world-readable
P001.remediation: Move booked_by out of the publicly readable boat document into an admin-only collection, and require auth to read boats/{id}/history.

P002.title: Retained rental log permits identity or location keys
P002.remediation: Remove identity and location keys from the rental_history hasOnly() allowlist in firestore.rules.

P003.title: GPS trail is written without an active-rental gate
P003.remediation: Gate history writes in cloud-ingest on tracking_enabled so idle boats never accumulate a trail.

P004.title: Check-in does not fully erase rental data
P004.remediation: Ensure check-in deletes boats/{id}/history and clears renter identity fields.

P005.title: Anonymisation claim overstates a pseudonymous record
P005.remediation: State precisely what is retained, or stop retaining the persistent device identifier.

P006.title: GPS trail retention is unbounded without a check-in
P006.remediation: Add a scheduled purge that deletes trails older than the maximum rental window.

P007.title: No consent artifact is recorded before location collection
P007.remediation: Record who consented, to what, and when, at check-out; keep it separate from general terms.

P008.title: No privacy policy link on a page that collects personal information
P008.remediation: Publish a consumer health data privacy policy and link it from every page that collects personal information.

acknowledged.reason: Pre-existing POC design: the public dashboard reads Firestore unauthenticated. Closing this requires splitting renter identity into an admin-only collection and adding auth to the public map, which is a product decision.
Trails are erased at check-in. An abandoned rental that is never checked in retains a trail indefinitely; a scheduled purge is planned alongside the GCP-to-Wix decision.
The check-out dialog discloses tracking verbally to the renter but records no consent artifact. Wording and record format need CWB counsel review before implementation.
CWB has no published consumer health data privacy policy yet. Blocked on the applicability determination in docs/privacy-compliance-review.md.
